summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected working Greek. They preserve the participants, commands, rock/gate distinction, stone count, conjectural negation, and shared carrying. The simplified edition’s shorter sentences retain the source’s substantive content. The notes distinguish editorial supplies from reported witness readings, disclose alternatives, and do not present internal parallels or manuscript gaps as independent support. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Acceptance is limited to the supplied working source and disclosure of the supplied reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify an exhaustive collation.
